## Problem

What happened, and which receiving task did it affect?

## Reproduction

List the version, local setup, steps, and minimal synthetic input needed to reproduce it.

## Expected and observed behavior

Explain each. Include the status/error message without tokens or operational data.

## Checks

- [ ] This report contains no credentials, real receipts, private photos, or personal data.
- [ ] Security-sensitive information was sent privately according to SECURITY.md.
- [ ] I identified whether the behavior was a local mock, deterministic rule, or actual configured model call.
